holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: The board approved Q2 FY2027 standalone net profit of ₹14,843 crore and consolidated net profit of ₹16,333 crore on October 17, 2026.
The bank's CASA ratio decreased by 340 basis points to 36.1% alongside an increase in FCNR (B) deposits.

expected.text: Nomura anticipated a 17% core PPOP growth for select private banks including ICICI Bank in Q2.

seeing.text: Brokerages noted a Q2 earnings beat, although the stock dropped 1% post-results.

holdings.why_it_matters: ICICI Bank is the fund's largest single holding at 6.46%. Its -3.87% 3-month return shaved an estimated 0.25% off portfolio performance.

watch.text: Brokerage upside targets including Emkay's target of ₹1,785 and Goldman Sachs's projections following Q2 results.

holdings.name: Axis Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: The bank appointed Rahul Shukla as Group Head of Commercial and Bharat Banking effective October 19, 2026.
Axis Bank posted September 2026 net profit of ₹7,666 crore compared to ₹5,567 crore in September 2025.

expected.text: Axis Bank's FY27 loan growth estimate was increased to 20%, while the FY28 forecast was held at 15%.

seeing.text: Shares slid over 4% as quarterly profit fell short of expectations despite a 38% year-on-year increase.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 5.27% fund weight, the stock fell -2.29% over 3 months and -12.29% over 6 months, dragging the fund's 27.1% financials allocation.

watch.text: Execution toward the revised 20% loan growth target for FY27.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: An internal investigation revealed that two senior executives leaked confidential business information.
Deputy MD Kaizad Bharucha will step down on December 31, 2026, while Lily Vadera was reappointed as independent director.
The bank reported Q2 standalone net profit of ₹21,537 crore on revenues of ₹95,132 crore.

expected.text: Nomura projected 17% core PPOP growth across private lenders including HDFC Bank in Q2.

seeing.text: Anand Rathi noted that the bank faces a long road to catch up after dropping 29% in 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 5.24% weight, HDFC Bank's 3-month drop of -6.13% made it the fund's second-biggest negative contributor at -0.321%, compounding its 1-year loss of -29.85%.

watch.text: Executive transition outcomes following Kaizad Bharucha's planned departure at year-end.

holdings.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd

what_changed.text: The company secured construction orders for Secretariat buildings in New Delhi and office towers in Amaravati.
L&T received an LNTP to initiate pre-construction work for the New Tashkent airport.
The Indian Navy commissioned the Samarthak warship built by L&T.

expected.text: Motilal Oswal projected 19% upside for the stock, while PL Capital estimated potential upside of up to 41%.

holdings.why_it_matters: L&T represents 3.82% of the fund and anchors its 15.2% Industrials basket. Its -4.75% 3-month return contributed to overall portfolio declines.

watch.text: Q2 and half-year financial results scheduled for board review and investor presentation on October 27, 2026.

holdings.name: State Bank of India

what_changed.text: SBI reported dark-web exposure of 3,897 customer records on October 16, 2026, while confirming customer balances remain safe.
The bank revised lending interest rates including the EBLR and RLL.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 3.43% fund weight, SBI dropped -6.05% over 3 months, aligning with broader headwinds across the fund's 27.1% financials book.

watch.text: Further disclosures or audits concerning the dark-web customer data leak.

holdings.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd

what_changed.text: The company introduced postpaid plans featuring international roaming and launched its IQ Gateway enterprise communication platform.
Airtel launched mass-market voice-only tariffs following regulatory directives from TRAI.
The Department of Telecommunications levied penalties for subscriber verification norm violations.

holdings.why_it_matters: Bharti Airtel forms 3.32% of the portfolio. Its -2.94% 3-month decline weighed on the fund's 13.1% technology and communications allocation.

watch.text: Market positioning relative to the newly listing Jio Platforms public issue.

holdings.name: Zomato Ltd

what_changed.text: Reported Q2 FY27 B2C gross order value growth of 54% YoY and adjusted revenue rise of 76% to ₹24,621 crore.
The board approved restructuring of the Going-out India business and an Adonmo-Mygate share swap valued at ₹156 crore.
Flipkart initiated testing of 'Eat-in by Minutes' food delivery, competing directly with Zomato.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 3.20% of the fund, Zomato returned 9.83% over 3 months, delivering a +0.315% contribution that cushioned fund returns.

watch.text: Growth trajectory in quick-commerce arm Blinkit and integration of the Mygate transaction.

holdings.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: The RBI approved Anup Kumar Saha as MD & CEO for a three-year period beginning January 1, 2027.
Provisional Q2 FY27 net advances reached ₹5,77,094 crore and deposits rose to ₹6,51,491 crore.

expected.text: Nomura anticipated a 17% core PPOP growth for private banks in Q2.

seeing.text: Shares rallied 3.7% following the strong provisional loan and deposit numbers, hitting 52-week highs.

holdings.why_it_matters: Kotak was the fund's top contributor over 3 months (+0.464%) via a 14.86% return, offsetting declines from higher-weighted banking holdings.

watch.text: Upcoming unaudited Q2 results and earnings conference call on October 24, 2026.

holdings.name: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd

what_changed.text: M&M's stake in NDET decreased to 49.63%, terminating its step-down subsidiary status.
The company launched the XUV 3XO CNG variant priced at ₹9.99 lakh.
Tata Motors overtook M&M for the number two car sales spot during the April-September period.

expected.text: Management indicated that the firm could sell 2,000 to 3,000 more electric vehicles monthly if supply constraints abate.

seeing.text: Tata Motors surpassed M&M in car volumes during the April-September timeframe.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 3.09% fund weight in Consumer Discretionary (10.4% sector weight), M&M's -9.02% 3-month return reduced fund performance by an estimated 0.279%.

watch.text: Easing of EV supply chain bottlenecks to enable higher monthly unit sales.

holdings.name: Reliance Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Jio Platforms initiated an IPO of up to 27 crore shares with a price band of ₹1,065 to ₹1,119, fully subscribing in 100 minutes on Day 1.
US Senator Marco Rubio visited Reliance's Jamnagar refinery complex.

holdings.why_it_matters: Reliance carries a 2.93% weight in the portfolio and leads its 8.6% Energy & Utilities sector. Its -6.18% 3-month loss subtracted from fund returns.

watch.text: Final listing outcome and capital allocation from the ₹30,213 crore Jio Platforms offering.

portfolio.statement: Franklin India Flexi Cap Fund declined -5.60% over 3 months and -8.23% over 1 year, burdened by weakness in major private and public lenders despite positive momentum in Kotak Mahindra Bank and Zomato.
interp: Financials account for 27.1% of the portfolio, making banking dispersion—such as HDFC Bank detractor effects vs Kotak Mahindra Bank gains—the key determinant of performance.
The top 10 positions comprise 39.9% of total assets, so concurrent multi-month declines across HDFC Bank, Axis Bank, and SBI concentrated negative returns.
portfolio.line: Heavy banking drag offsets gains in platform tech and capital goods orders.

drivers.text: HDFC Bank fell -6.13% over 3 months, detracting -0.321% amid news of internal information leaks.
Axis Bank fell more than 4% following Q2 results that trailed profit expectations.
Kotak Mahindra Bank rose 14.86% over 3 months and added +0.464% following solid provisional advances and deposit data.
Zomato added +0.315% over 3 months on 54% YoY B2C gross order growth.

themes.title: Private Banking Divergence
themes.text: Kotak Mahindra Bank advanced on strong provisional deposit figures, while peers Axis Bank and HDFC Bank fell on earnings misses and internal data leak probes.

themes.title: Platform and Fast Delivery Expansion
themes.text: Digital platforms are showing rapid gross order value expansion even as new entrants like Flipkart test fast food delivery.

macro.factor: Deposit Costs and Lending Rate Adjustments
macro.why: Lenders adjusted benchmark lending rates while experiencing shifts in CASA deposits and foreign currency liabilities.
Public and institutional civil works tenders translated into multi-city construction and defense awards.

priced_in.text: Day-one demand for the Jio Platforms ₹30,213 crore IPO was fully absorbed by investors in 100 minutes.
Axis Bank's Q2 earnings shortfall was immediately discounted by a 4% single-day stock decline.

could_change.title: Automotive Component Supply Normalization
could_change.text: Mahindra & Mahindra's EV sales could rise by 2,000 to 3,000 units monthly if critical supply bottlenecks clear.

could_change.title: Management Leadership Transitions in Core Banking
could_change.text: Leadership updates at Axis Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank take effect in late 2026 and early 2027, potentially influencing credit strategies.

portfolio.risk_note: A 27.1% concentration in Financials leaves the fund heavily exposed to margin contraction, cybersecurity liabilities, and asset growth decelerations across large-cap banks.
